disc.brief: Every job starts as a brief: what, how many, where, by when.

disc.press: The offset press prints stationery and brochures in volume.

disc.printer: The wide-format printer handles vinyl, banners and large graphics.
disc.roll: Vinyl on the roll, ready to be printed and cut to shape.
disc.laminator: Lamination protects the print from scuffs and sun.
disc.finishing: The cutting table trims each print to its outline.
disc.applied: The finished graphic, applied. Concept art, not client work.
disc.dock: Checked, packed and out the door: delivered or installed.
